answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-bound identity: every agent must lock collateral in a shared registry before its vote counts, and one hardware attestation may anchor only one identity. A forger who wants N fake agents must post N separate stakes, so influence is priced instead of free, and a detected clone loses its whole bond. A raven auditor watches the inlet where identities are admitted, and validators on cedar reject any second key traced to the same device.
